Greasy food and floor
Apr 2019 • Couples
We visited the place after learning it is highly recommended on TripAdvisor. 

A plus point is the staff were smiley and very nice to us. However, there are 2 minus points. First, the pancake was too oily for both shrimp and beef topping. The beef and the dipping sauce were so sugary we couldn't eat much. Second, we really concerned the hygiene of this place where the floor and literally everywhere (on the wall, tables, utensils, etc.) was covered with a greasy layer of oil which made every touch either so slippery or sticky. There was even something like a bit of tissue in my partner’s beer mug!!

We definitely will not come back here again.

Delicious
Mar 2019 • Friends
We were taken there whilst on a tour from our resort. It’s very basic and although they are starting to get a lot of tourists in, it’s a genuine “local” restaurant, that caters mainly for “locals”.

No menus required as they specialize in Bahn Xeo (rolled spring rolls) … your choice of beef or prawn, add your own salad/greens/herbs/cucumber/bean sprouts etc, and sauce. 

A great tasting combination, both moist and crunchy, with chili and sweet and sour to taste.

Would definitely go back.

PS, They said no beer, but when our guide asked them they went and got me a nice cold one (next door I think)
